body_excerpt: **[Crates.io](https://crates.io/crates/svgtypes/0.16.2) | [Docs](https://docs.rs/svgtypes/0.16.2/svgtypes/index.html)** This release has an MSRV of 1.85. ### Added - Support `hwb()` colors. (#63 by @simartin) - Support angle units for the hue in `hsl()` and `hsla()`. (#62 by @simartin) - Support the `/` separator before the alpha component in `rgb()`, `hsl()` and friends. (#64 by @simartin) ### Fixed - Accept all non-ASCII ident code points in CSS identifiers, so unquoted font-family names such as `café` parse. (#71 by @mamicicekel) - Return an error instead of panicking on invalid `transform-origin` values. (#65 by @ChrisJr404)
